edit.publish_now: Publish it now (leave this off to keep it as a draft only you can see)

notifications.new_entry_setting: Someone posts an update to a build I follow

settings.currency_help: Shown before money amounts, like what a build has cost so far.
settings.max_upload_kb_help: For photos stored by Garage. Big phone photos are shrunk in the browser before they are sent.
settings.use_fof_upload_help: Photos go through FoF Upload (its storage and its size limits) for members who may upload files there. Turn it off to keep them in Garage's own storage.

permissions.create: Add builds and post build log updates
permissions.moderate: Edit, feature and delete anyone's builds and comments

categories.title: Categories
categories.help: Builds are sorted into categories, and each category has its own spec sheet. A car forum might have Cars and Bikes; a PC forum, Desktops and Laptops.
categories.delete_confirm_move: Delete the category {name}? Its {count, plural, one {# build moves} other {# builds move}} to {to}.
categories.delete_last: This is the only category, and it has builds. Add another category first, so the builds have somewhere to go.
categories.fields_help: The details members fill in for a build in this category, like Engine, Power and Color. Renaming a field keeps every build's value.
categories.filter: Members can filter by it on the Garage page
categories.icon_help: A Font Awesome icon, like fas fa-car, fas fa-computer, fas fa-guitar or fas fa-seedling.
categories.name: Name
categories.summary: {fields, plural, one {# field} other {# fields}} · {builds, plural, one {# build} other {# builds}}

gdpr.export: Garage: the member's builds with their photos, spec sheets, stories and build logs, and their comments.
gdpr.delete: Garage: the member's builds (photos and build logs included), comments, likes and follows are deleted.

api.last_category: The last category can't be deleted while it has builds.
api.photo_not_found: That photo couldn't be found. Upload it again.
api.text_too_long: That's too long to save. Shorten it and try again.
